facts.text: The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment for joining, offered as Cedric's promissory note.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the note was already handed over to the recruits or payment is still owed.

facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note pays 975 gold pieces (three-quarters price for the party's treasure) once the caravans flow again.
facts.uncertain_reason: The note may have been given to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda as payment.
